title: I'm the Final Boss of This Town
summary: Four hundred heroes try to fight a baker’s kid, and he puts them to work. Then the priest reads his little sister’s class.
frame_0: The blue-shirted baker sleeps on the step under a red FINAL BOSS bar. Steel-armoured heroes with individual health bars crowd the bakery street in the red-purple evening light.
package_differences: Jake’s look revision replaces daylight with bakery-gold and purple dusk, and the people wear flat colours with classic block heads and simple ink faces.
The first 25 seconds use steady camera setups. One smooth camera travels from the second bakery to the pay booth, dragon, street fracture, working kitchen and the sister’s bar.
The soundtrack uses the supplied story performance and timed street, oven, armour and dish Foley.
The sponsor version has the approved spoken 9.3-second Flashloop phone ending. The clean version ends on the sister’s bar.
